newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's Shell lowers fuel prices, diesel unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Manila's Shell lowers fuel prices, diesel unchanged.

text.p: Pilipinas Shell Petroleum Corp (PSPC) said on Friday it will cut prices of all petroleum products, except diesel, effective on May 10.

In a statement, the company said it will reduce the pump prices of premium gasoline by 27 centavos per litre to 11.40 pesos; unleaded gasoline by 34 centavos to 10.99 pesos, and regular gasoline by 35 centavos to 10.04 pesos.
Kerosene prices will be cut by 40 centavos to 6.43 pesos per litre.
PSPC said the price of diesel will remain the same at 7.70 pesos a litre.
The wholesale posted price of fuel oil will be lowered by four centavos to 3.8029 pesos per litre while jet fuel will be reduced by 35 centavos to 8.9281 pesos.
Pilipinas Shell said that the adjustments were brought on by lower Singapore Posted Prices, the benchmark used by the country's three oil refiners in determining monthly domestic fuel prices.
Pilipinas Shell is a unit of the Royal Dutch/Shell group of companies.
